name: io.github.Srinivasan-78/repo2graph
title: repo2graph
description: Ask a codebase questions and get cited code back, from a tree-sitter graph of the repo.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server lives behind the `mcp` extra: the CLI and the GitHub Action never import the SDK, so it is not a runtime dependency of the base package.
The console script to run out of that package. The bare `repo2graph` entry point is the CLI, not the server.

packageArguments.description: The repository to serve. Its index is built into <repo_path>/.r2g on the first tool call if one does not exist yet, so no setup step is needed.
